LanguageData.KCJ_Gizmo_Desc: When enabled, the monument blueprint will keep only the outer walls (perimeter). The interior will be cleared, and you only need to build the outer walls for the monument to be considered complete.\n\nNote: Once completed in Empty Fort mode, there is a daily chance of discovery during the protection period. If discovered, the quest will fail and relations with the quest-giving faction will deteriorate. Click again to disable and restore the full blueprint.
LanguageData.KCJ_Enabled_Message: Empty Fort Strategy activated: the monument only needs its outer walls to be considered complete.
LanguageData.KCJ_Disabled_Message: Empty Fort Strategy deactivated: full blueprint restored.
LanguageData.KCJ_Confirm_Text:
With this strategy, the monument only needs to build those solid outer walls to be considered "complete" — the inside can be as empty as a drum.

But you can't fool the heavens forever: during the protection period after completion, there is a daily chance of being "discovered." Once exposed, the quest will fail immediately and relations with the commissioning faction will deteriorate.

Confirm activation of Empty Fort mode?
LanguageData.KCJ_Exposed_Text:
Deception and truth, finally seen through.

The commissioning faction has seen through your empty fort. The monument quest has been judged a failure. They have taken offense: your relations have been reduced by {0}.

The faction's penalties will be triggered in 4 hours.

You have a 4-hour window to hold the "Empty Fort — Blame Shift" ritual to stop the raid. Holding it within 24 hours can still reduce the relation penalty.
LanguageData.KCJ_Exposed_Message: Empty Fort Strategy exposed!{0} Quest failed.\nThe faction's penalties will be triggered in 4 hours. Hold the "Empty Fort — Blame Shift" ritual within 4 hours to stop the raid, or within 24 hours to reduce the relation penalty.
LanguageData.KCJ_Warning_Message: Empty Fort exposure warning: the faction's penalties will be triggered in {0}. Hold the "Empty Fort — Blame Shift" ritual to banish a pawn to calm their anger.
LanguageData.KCJ_Penalty_Letter_Text: The commissioning faction's penalty has arrived!\n\nIf you had held the "Empty Fort — Blame Shift" ritual within 4 hours, this raid could have been stopped. Holding it within 24 hours could have at least reduced the relation penalty.
LanguageData.KCJ_Warning_Letter_Text:
The Empty Fort has been seen through! The faction's penalties will be triggered in 4 hours (if the original quest included a raid penalty, a raid will occur).

You have a 4-hour window to hold the "Empty Fort — Blame Shift" ritual to stop the raid. Holding it within 24 hours can still restore {0}% of the relation penalty.

Select the exposed monument and click the "Blame Shift" button, or use the cultural ritual to banish a "Full Employee" (colonist) or "Intern" (slave) to perform the blame shift.

You may also choose not to hold the ritual and face the consequences.
LanguageData.KCJ_BlameShift_Gizmo_Desc: After the Empty Fort is exposed, hold a blame shift ritual to banish a "Full Employee" (colonist) or "Intern" (slave). Within 4 hours, this can prevent the faction's attack. Within 24 hours, it can still restore part of the relation penalty.\n\nNo cultural meme or extra setup required — available as soon as the Empty Fort is seen through.
LanguageData.KCJ_BlameShift_Confirm_Text: The Empty Fort has been seen through! You will banish a pawn to take the blame.\n\nAfter banishment, the pawn will leave your colony forever. If done within 4 hours, it can stop the faction's attack. Within 24 hours, it can still restore part of the relation penalty.
LanguageData.KCJ_BlameShift_Select_Pawn: Select a pawn to be the scapegoat:

No cultural meme or extra setup required — available once the monument is completed.

LanguageData.KCJ_Research_Quest_Letter_Text:
"Empty Fort Strategy" research complete!

A big job just came in — a monument commission "{0}", twice the scale of usual.

Select the monument and click the "Empty Fort Strategy" button to activate the shortcut mode — only the outer walls need to be built. But beware: during the protection period after completion, there is a daily chance of discovery. If exposed, the quest fails and relations deteriorate.

LanguageData.KCJ_Settings_Ritual_Desc: Auto-triggers on any cultural ritual with "Good" or above quality — no need to configure in "Edit Ideogram".\n\nYou can also click the "Propaganda" button on a completed monument to trigger it manually (1-day cooldown).
LanguageData.KCJ_Settings_Ritual_Chance: Chance to refresh a monument quest when ritual quality is Good or above: {0}%
LanguageData.KCJ_Settings_Ritual_Tooltip:
"Empty Fort — Propaganda" is a cultural ritual effect. After assigning it to a ritual, if the ritual ends with a quality of "Good" or above, there is this chance to generate a new monument (build and protect) quest.

This is the "ritual effect trigger" chance, default 100%, adjustable between 0% and 100%. Setting it to 0% means no quest will be generated even if the ritual succeeds.

This is independent from the "Monument quest (normal) appearance rate" setting above — the above adjusts the frequency of normal monument quests (default 100%); this one adds an extra chance to receive a monument quest after a ritual.
LanguageData.KCJ_Settings_Propaganda_Duration_Tooltip: How long the propaganda ceremony lasts (in-game hours). After the ceremony ends, quality is calculated. Default: 2 hours.
LanguageData.KCJ_Settings_Note: Note: Click the "Empty Fort Strategy" button on the monument again to disable this mode.
